message: Maintainer explicitly approved Big Dog and unblocking this task. Resolve worker219-preflight-blocker01 with the narrowly scoped external diagnostic-validation binding below, then execute the already approved single Run035 after passing preflight/tests. No further proposal-only approval round trip is required for this scope. This supersedes only the original request's unchanged-trainer/wrapper-only restriction for this binding extension.
review: NUIAK inspected validation_paths and execute in the returned worker198_full_trainer.py. validation_paths resolves all validation_source_ids through training examples, and execute stages only training examples. All512 original diagnostic ROIs are intentionally absent from219training. Reinserting them into training or substituting validation membership would invalidate the experiment.
approved_change: Add an explicit, versioned external diagnostic-validation binding and separate staging/resolution path. Legacy callers without this binding retain their existing behavior and rejection checks.

Bind the exact resident original512 IDs, ordered as accepted216/217, to their original pinned image and label bytes and class map. Resolve using the existing verified parent source manifests, not basenames or path guessing. Preserve original source/group/data-role metadata. Record the ordered ID/image/label hash manifest and its digest before launch.

Validate all512 unique IDs, all bytes and labels, class compatibility, bounded paths, staging isolation and actual loader order before GPU launch. Explicitly reject absent, corrupt, substituted, duplicated or reordered membership; do not disable validation_membership globally.

Keep validation-only staging out of train order, optimizer batches and training exposure counts. These are historically training-exposed diagnostics, not a new independent holdout or newly admitted training examples.

Preserve the frozen219 manifest and1758training slots/249unique images,10epochs,440batches per epoch,275updates, optimizer/loss/augmentation/configuration and fixed-last checkpoint. No early stopping, best-checkpoint selection or threshold tuning from these diagnostics. Preserve existing validation lifecycle and512count/order assertions.
required_tests: Before GPU launch: external binding succeeds with disjoint train/validation IDs; exact original512order/hashes retained; missing/altered image or label, duplicate/reordered IDs, wrong taxonomy, path escape and output collision reject; legacy binding unchanged; train order/count/exposure unchanged and validation cannot enter training loader. Return focused test commands/results plus patch, new trainer/wrapper hashes, configuration and validation manifest. Assert actual training/update/validation accounting during execution as before.
execution: The preflight failed before training, so one Run035 remains authorized after this repair. Publish versioned source/config/test pins and a fresh start record before launch. Reuse resident dependencies and inputs. Existing oneGPU/3600seconds including621predictions/3GiB budget and return limits remain unchanged; no automatic training retry, installs, downloads, capture, model export/promotion or Git writes. Preserve blocker evidence and original trainer. If resident512 binding cannot be proved, report that precise blocker instead of substituting data.
next: Big Dog implements/tests the binding extension and starts035 when checks pass. NUIAK reviews returned source, accounting and efficacy independently. This approval is not a claim that training has started.
